column1: Design a hybrid logical clock scheme that combines physical and logical timestamps for causal ordering across a multi-datacenter deployment.
Implement a distributed rate limiter using the sliding-window-counter algorithm and explain how it avoids the burst problem of fixed windows at boundaries.
Design a leader-based replication system's failover procedure that avoids split-brain when the network partitions the old leader from the majority.
Explain how vector clocks detect concurrent updates in a distributed key-value store and why they don't scale well past a few hundred nodes.
Design an idempotency-key mechanism for a payment API that must survive client retries and server crashes without double-charging.
Implement a gossip-based cluster membership protocol (SWIM-style) and explain how it distinguishes a slow node from a failed one.
Design a multi-tier caching architecture (client, CDN, edge, origin) with cache-invalidation propagation that bounds staleness to under 5 seconds.
Explain how a distributed tracing system reconstructs a request's causal span tree across asynchronous message queues without clock synchronization.
Design a blue-green deployment pipeline for a stateful service that must preserve in-flight transactions during cutover.
Design a cross-region data replication strategy for a multi-tenant SaaS product that meets a 15-minute RPO and satisfies data-residency law for EU tenants.
Explain the trade-offs between synchronous and asynchronous multi-region write replication for a banking ledger, and design a hybrid that bounds financial risk.
Design a distributed rate-limiting system that must remain accurate under clock skew across regions without a centralized counter.
Design a sharded counter service that supports high-throughput increments with eventually consistent reads bounded to under 1 second staleness.
Design a failure-detector-based auto-scaling controller for a stateful sharded service that avoids thrashing during flapping load.
Explain how chain replication with apportioned queries improves read throughput over primary-backup replication, and quantify the latency trade-off for the tail replica.
Design a two-tier consensus architecture where a small Raft group elects leaders for many independent shard groups, and analyze its scalability limits.
Prove that eventual consistency under a CRDT-based system converges to the same state regardless of message delivery order, using a join-semilattice argument.
Design a formally specified atomic broadcast protocol and prove it satisfies total order and validity under a crash-stop failure model.
Design a globally ordered, exactly-once distributed transaction log spanning heterogeneous storage engines, and prove its linearizability guarantee.
Formally prove the impossibility of achieving both strong consistency and availability during a network partition (CAP theorem) using an indistinguishability argument.
Implement an interval tree supporting overlap queries and prove its O(log n + k) query time where k is the output size.
Design an algorithm to find all articulation points and bridges in an undirected graph in O(V+E) using DFS low-link values.
Implement a trie with compressed paths (radix tree) supporting prefix counting, and analyze its space complexity versus a naive trie.
Design an algorithm for the longest increasing subsequence problem in O(n log n) using patience sorting, and prove correctness.
Implement a treap supporting split and merge in expected O(log n) time, and explain how randomized priorities guarantee balance.
Design a sweep-line algorithm to count all intersecting pairs among n line segments in O(n log n) time.
Implement a disjoint sparse table supporting O(1) range minimum queries with O(n log n) preprocessing, and compare to a sparse table's overlap-friendly limitation for non-idempotent operations.
Design an algorithm to compute the convex hull of n points in O(n log n) using the Graham scan, and prove its correctness via the polar-angle ordering invariant.
Implement a Fenwick tree (BIT) supporting range updates and range sum queries simultaneously using two auxiliary trees.
Design an algorithm for finding the maximum flow in a graph using Dinic's algorithm and prove its O(V^2 E) time bound.
Implement a persistent union-find data structure supporting rollbacks to any previous version in O(log n) per operation.
Design an algorithm to compute the Burrows-Wheeler transform of a string and explain how it enables the FM-index for O(m) pattern search.
Implement a centroid decomposition of a tree and use it to answer path-length queries in O(log n) per query after O(n log n) preprocessing.
Design an algorithm to solve the assignment problem using the Hungarian algorithm in O(n^3) and prove its optimality via LP duality.
Implement a Mo's algorithm solution for offline range queries and derive its O((n+q)sqrt(n)) time complexity.
Prove the correctness of the Aho-Corasick automaton for multi-pattern string matching and derive its O(n+m+z) time bound.
Design a parallel prefix-sum (scan) algorithm with O(log n) depth and prove its work-efficiency is O(n).
Prove that the 3-SUM problem cannot be solved faster than O(n^2) under the 3-SUM conjecture, and discuss its use as a hardness-reduction target.
Design a succinct data structure representing a balanced parenthesis sequence in 2n+o(n) bits supporting O(1) find-matching-parenthesis queries.
Prove the optimality of the Ukkonen's linear-time suffix tree construction algorithm and explain the amortized analysis behind its suffix links.
Design a multi-tenant Kubernetes-based platform architecture with resource quotas, network policies, and noisy-neighbor isolation for 10,000 tenants.
Design an event-sourced architecture for an order-management system with snapshotting to bound replay time as the event log grows.
Design a webhook delivery system that guarantees at-least-once delivery with exponential backoff and dead-letter queues for permanently failing endpoints.
Design an API gateway architecture that performs request coalescing to protect a backend from thundering-herd cache-miss storms.
Design a multi-region active-passive disaster recovery architecture for a relational database with automated failover and split-brain prevention.
Design a chat application backend supporting 1M concurrent WebSocket connections with horizontal scaling and message ordering guarantees per conversation.
Design a rate-limited, priority-aware job queue architecture for a video transcoding pipeline with SLA tiers for different customer plans.
Design a data lake ingestion architecture that handles schema evolution across millions of daily events without breaking downstream consumers.
Design the architecture of a ride-sharing dispatch system matching drivers to riders in real time with geo-sharded state and surge-pricing computation.
Design a globally distributed feature-flag service with sub-50ms propagation and graceful degradation if the control plane is unreachable.
Design an architecture for a collaborative document editor (Google-Docs-style) supporting offline editing with operational transform conflict resolution.
Design an observability platform ingesting 10M metrics/sec with downsampling, long-term storage, and sub-second dashboard query latency.
Design a fraud-detection pipeline for a payments platform combining real-time streaming scoring with asynchronous batch model retraining.
Design a multiplayer matchmaking system that balances skill-based fairness against queue-time latency across regional server pools.
Design the architecture for a video streaming platform's adaptive bitrate delivery system with per-user QoE optimization under variable bandwidth.
Design a planet-scale identity and access management system supporting sub-100ms authorization decisions with revocation propagating in under 1 second.
Design a full architecture for a real-time collaborative spreadsheet engine handling cross-cell dependency recalculation at scale, with formal consistency guarantees.
Design the end-to-end architecture of a high-frequency trading system's market-data ingestion path with deterministic sub-microsecond jitter bounds.
Derive the KL-divergence-based objective for knowledge distillation and explain why matching soft-label temperature affects the student model's calibration.
Explain the vanishing gradient problem in vanilla RNNs and derive how LSTM gating mitigates it via the constant error carousel.
Derive the closed-form update for ridge regression and explain how it relates to a Gaussian prior on the weights in a Bayesian interpretation.
Explain how contrastive loss (InfoNCE) in self-supervised learning relates to mutual information maximization between augmented views.
Derive the policy gradient theorem and explain why the baseline subtraction reduces variance without introducing bias.
Explain how batch normalization changes the loss landscape's smoothness and why this improves gradient descent convergence.
Derive the attention mechanism's computational complexity and explain how linear attention approximations trade expressiveness for O(n) scaling.
Explain why label smoothing improves model calibration and derive its effect on the gradient of the cross-entropy loss.
Derive the evidence lower bound for a hierarchical variational autoencoder and explain the posterior collapse failure mode.
Explain how RLHF's reward model can be exploited via reward hacking, and design a KL-regularization scheme to bound policy divergence from the base model.
Derive the gradient of the Wasserstein distance used in WGAN training and explain why it avoids the vanishing-gradient problem of the original GAN objective.
Explain the mathematical basis of rotary position embeddings (RoPE) and derive why they preserve relative-position information under attention.
Derive the expected calibration error metric and design a temperature-scaling post-hoc calibration method with a proof of monotonicity.
Explain how sparse mixture-of-experts models achieve conditional computation, and derive the expected FLOPs savings versus a dense model of equal parameter count.
Design an active-learning acquisition function based on expected model change and derive why it favors high-uncertainty, high-influence samples.
Prove a PAC learning sample-complexity bound for a finite hypothesis class and explain how it generalizes to VC-dimension-based bounds for infinite classes.
Derive the exact recurrence for computing gradients through a state-space model (e.g. Mamba/S4) and explain how the parallel scan makes training tractable.
Design an information-theoretic proof that a transformer's induction heads implement an approximation of a Bayesian predictor under a specific data-generating process.
Derive the exact generalization gap for overparameterized linear regression in the interpolation regime and connect it to the double descent phenomenon's variance term.
Prove a tight sample-complexity lower bound for learning halfspaces under adversarial label noise, using an information-theoretic argument.
Prove that every finite group of prime order is cyclic, using Lagrange's theorem.
Prove the fundamental theorem of arithmetic (unique prime factorization) using well-ordering and Euclid's lemma.
Prove that the harmonic series diverges using the integral test, and estimate its growth rate via the Euler-Mascheroni constant.
Prove Cauchy-Schwarz inequality in an inner product space and derive its equality condition.
Prove that a continuous function on a closed interval attains its maximum (extreme value theorem) using compactness.
Prove the pigeonhole principle's generalized form and apply it to show a bound on Ramsey number R(3,3).
Prove that the square root of any non-perfect-square integer is irrational, generalizing the classic proof for sqrt(2).
Prove Bayes' theorem from the definition of conditional probability and apply it to derive the posterior update in a naive Bayes classifier.
Prove the Cayley-Bacharach theorem for cubic curves and outline its connection to elliptic curve group law associativity.
Prove the Perron-Frobenius theorem for positive matrices and explain its role in guaranteeing PageRank's convergence.
Prove the Lagrange four-square theorem, that every natural number is the sum of four integer squares.
Prove Jensen's inequality for convex functions and derive the AM-GM inequality as a special case.
Prove the existence and uniqueness of the QR decomposition for a full-rank matrix via Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization.
Prove the Weierstrass approximation theorem, that continuous functions on a closed interval can be uniformly approximated by polynomials.
Prove Sylow's first theorem on the existence of Sylow p-subgroups using group action on cosets.
Prove the Baire category theorem and use it to show the existence of a continuous nowhere-differentiable function.
Prove the Hahn-Banach theorem in the real vector space case and explain its role in guaranteeing the existence of separating hyperplanes.
Prove Ramsey's theorem for infinite graphs (infinite Ramsey theorem) using the pigeonhole principle and induction.
Prove the Bolzano-Weierstrass theorem and use it to establish sequential compactness of closed bounded sets in R^n.
Prove the Nullstellensatz (weak form) over an algebraically closed field and explain its role in the correspondence between ideals and varieties.
Prove the four-color theorem's reduction to a finite set of unavoidable configurations, and explain why this proof resists a fully human-verifiable form.
Design a Diffie-Hellman key exchange protocol resistant to man-in-the-middle attacks by adding a certificate-based authentication layer, and identify residual attack surfaces.
Explain how a timing side-channel in RSA modular exponentiation leaks key bits, and design a constant-time implementation using Montgomery ladder.
Design a secure password hashing scheme using Argon2 and justify the memory-hardness parameter choices against GPU cracking attacks.
Explain the BEAST attack against CBC-mode TLS 1.0 and design a mitigation that doesn't require protocol version downgrade.
Design a JWT-based authentication scheme resistant to algorithm-confusion attacks (e.g. RS256/HS256 substitution) and key-injection vulnerabilities.
Explain how a replay attack against a challenge-response authentication protocol works, and design a nonce-and-timestamp scheme to prevent it.
Design a secure random number generator seeding strategy for a Linux container that avoids low-entropy boot-time vulnerabilities.
Explain how the Bleichenbacher attack against PKCS#1 v1.5 padding works, and design a countermeasure that avoids oracle-distinguishable error responses.
Design a certificate transparency log architecture with Merkle-tree-based proofs of inclusion and consistency, and explain how it detects mis-issued certificates.
Explain how differential power analysis extracts an AES key from a smart card's power trace, and design a masking countermeasure.
Design an OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow with PKCE and identify which specific attack it prevents relative to the implicit flow.
Explain the mathematical structure of a Merkle-Damgard hash extension attack and design a construction (e.g. HMAC) that is provably immune to it.
Design a threshold signature scheme (e.g. based on Shamir secret sharing) for a multi-sig wallet, and explain its security under a t-of-n adversary model.
Explain how a rowhammer attack flips bits in DRAM to escalate privileges, and design a mitigation using target row refresh.
Design a rate-limited, replay-resistant one-time-password protocol (TOTP-style) and analyze its security against clock-skew exploitation.
Prove the security of the ElGamal encryption scheme under the decisional Diffie-Hellman assumption using a reduction argument.
Design a verifiable random function (VRF) construction and prove its uniqueness and pseudorandomness properties under standard assumptions.
Explain how a fault-injection attack (e.g. voltage glitching) can bypass a secure boot signature check, and design a redundant-verification countermeasure.
Design a fully homomorphic encryption bootstrapping procedure and explain how it resets ciphertext noise without decrypting, per Gentry's construction.
Prove the security of the Fiat-Shamir transform for converting an interactive zero-knowledge proof into a non-interactive one in the random oracle model.
Design a parser combinator library for a small expression language and explain how it handles left-recursion without infinite loops.
Implement a recursive-descent parser for a C-like language's arithmetic expressions with correct operator precedence and associativity.
Design a simple stack-based virtual machine bytecode format and implement its interpreter loop with proper instruction dispatch.
Explain how tail-call optimization is implemented at the calling-convention level and why it requires specific stack-frame reuse.
Design a symbol table implementation for a compiler supporting nested lexical scopes with O(1) average lookup.
Implement a constant-folding optimization pass over an AST and explain how it must handle floating-point non-associativity correctly.
Design a simple mark-and-sweep garbage collector's root-set identification strategy for a stack-based interpreter.
Explain how a lexer's maximal-munch tokenization rule can create ambiguity, and design a rule to resolve the classic '>>' template-closing conflict in C++.
Design a register-based bytecode VM (as opposed to stack-based) and analyze the dispatch-overhead trade-off versus a stack machine.
Implement an LL(1) parser table construction algorithm from a context-free grammar, and explain how to detect and resolve FIRST/FOLLOW conflicts.
Design an escape analysis pass for a compiler that promotes heap allocations to the stack, and prove it preserves program semantics.
Explain how a compiler implements exception handling using zero-cost unwinding tables instead of setjmp/longjmp, and analyze its runtime trade-offs.
Design a monomorphization strategy for compiling generic functions in a statically typed language, and analyze the code-size versus performance trade-off versus type erasure.
Implement a data-flow analysis framework for reaching definitions and use it to build a live-variable analysis pass.
Design a memory model for a language's concurrency primitives and explain what compiler reorderings it must forbid to remain sequentially-consistent-for-data-race-free programs.
Design a gradual typing system that inserts runtime casts at the static/dynamic type boundary, and prove it satisfies the gradual guarantee.
Design a whole-program dataflow-based points-to analysis (Andersen-style) and analyze its cubic worst-case time complexity.
Design a proof-carrying-code system where the compiler emits a machine-checkable proof of memory safety alongside the binary.
Design a formally verified optimizing compiler pass (in the style of CompCert) for instruction scheduling, and specify what semantic-preservation theorem it must satisfy.
Design a dependent-type-checking algorithm with bidirectional type inference and prove its decidability given a normalizing type theory.
Design a write-ahead logging scheme for a key-value store that supports group commit to amortize fsync latency across concurrent transactions.
Explain how a hash join operator spills to disk when the build side exceeds memory, and design a grace-hash-join partitioning scheme.
Design a bitmap index for a column store supporting fast AND/OR queries over low-cardinality columns.
Explain how a database's buffer pool eviction policy (e.g. LRU-K) reduces sequential-scan pollution compared to plain LRU.
Design a schema-migration system for a live production database that avoids long-held locks on large tables.
Explain how a covering index eliminates the need for a table-lookup step in a query plan, and design one for a common range-query pattern.
Design a connection-pooling and statement-caching layer for a database driver that minimizes per-query parsing overhead under high concurrency.
Explain how a columnar storage format's run-length and dictionary encoding interact with predicate pushdown for filter evaluation.
Design a distributed two-phase commit coordinator that recovers correctly from a coordinator crash using a persistent decision log.
Explain how MVCC garbage collection (vacuuming) determines which old row versions are safe to reclaim in the presence of long-running transactions.
Design a hash-partitioned distributed join algorithm that minimizes network shuffle for a star-schema query pattern.
Design an adaptive query execution engine that re-optimizes a query plan mid-execution based on observed cardinality versus estimated cardinality.
Explain how a log-structured merge tree's bloom filters reduce read amplification, and derive the optimal bits-per-key given a target false-positive rate.
Design a change-data-capture pipeline that reads a database's write-ahead log to produce an ordered, exactly-once event stream for downstream consumers.
Design a distributed deadlock-detection algorithm for a database using a wait-for graph, and analyze its message complexity across shards.
Design a formally specified serializability checker that validates a transaction history against strict serializability using a dependency-graph acyclicity proof.
Design a crash-consistent, copy-on-write LSM-tree variant that supports point-in-time snapshots without pausing writes.
Design a database's optimistic concurrency control protocol with validation-phase certification, and prove it prevents all write-skew anomalies under serializable isolation.
Design a lock-free ring buffer for a single-producer single-consumer scenario and prove it satisfies linearizability without any atomic read-modify-write instructions.
Implement a spinlock with exponential backoff and explain why it reduces cache-line contention versus a naive test-and-set spinlock.
Explain how memory-mapped I/O interacts with the page cache to avoid redundant copies during a large file read.
Design a thread pool implementation with work-stealing deques and explain how it avoids the head-of-line contention of a single shared queue.
Explain how a copy-on-write fork() implementation defers page duplication, and analyze the overhead of the resulting page-fault handling.
Design a priority-inheritance protocol for a real-time operating system's mutex implementation to bound priority-inversion duration.
Explain how the Linux kernel's epoll implementation avoids the O(n) scanning cost of select()/poll() for large numbers of file descriptors.
Design a hierarchical timer wheel data structure for an OS scheduler supporting O(1) amortized timer insertion and expiration.
Design a NUMA-aware slab allocator and analyze how per-node free lists reduce remote-memory-access latency under high allocation churn.
Explain how a seqlock allows lock-free readers to coexist with a writer, and identify why it's unsuitable for protecting pointer-containing data structures.
Design a copy-on-write page-table sharing scheme for containerized workloads and analyze its TLB-shootdown overhead on fork-heavy workloads.
Design a real-time earliest-deadline-first scheduler and derive the schedulability test (utilization bound) it must satisfy.
Explain how transactional memory (HTM) detects conflicting memory accesses using cache-coherence snooping, and design a software fallback path for aborted transactions.
Design a lock-free hazard-pointer-based memory reclamation scheme and explain how it prevents use-after-free without stopping all threads.
Explain how io_uring's submission/completion ring buffers reduce syscall overhead versus traditional blocking I/O, and analyze its memory-ordering requirements.
Design a formally verified spinlock implementation and prove deadlock-freedom under the sequential consistency memory model.
Design a scalable MCS-style queue lock and prove it achieves O(1) remote memory references per lock acquisition regardless of contention.
Design a portfolio optimization system incorporating a Black-Litterman model to blend market equilibrium returns with subjective investor views.
Derive the put-call parity relationship for European options and explain how violations create risk-free arbitrage opportunities.
Design a delta-hedging simulation for an options market maker and derive the hedging error's dependence on rehedging frequency.
Derive the duration and convexity of a fixed-coupon bond and explain how they approximate price sensitivity to yield changes.
Design a pairs-trading strategy backtester incorporating transaction costs and slippage, and explain how to avoid look-ahead bias in the simulation.
Derive the Sharpe ratio's statistical properties and explain why naive maximization overfits to backtested noise without a deflated-Sharpe correction.
Design a factor-based risk model (e.g. Barra-style) decomposing portfolio variance into systematic and idiosyncratic components.
Derive the forward rate agreement pricing formula from the no-arbitrage relationship between spot and forward interest rates.
Design a stochastic control formulation for optimal trade execution (Almgren-Chriss) balancing market impact against timing risk, and derive the optimal trading trajectory.
Derive the local volatility surface from market option prices using Dupire's formula, and explain its relationship to the implied volatility smile.
Design a copula-based dependence model for a multi-asset credit portfolio and explain its role in and limitations for CDO tranche pricing.
Derive the Vasicek short-rate model's bond pricing formula and explain the mean-reversion parameter's effect on the yield curve's shape.
Design a risk-parity portfolio construction algorithm and derive the fixed-point iteration used to equalize marginal risk contributions.
Derive the Greeks (delta, gamma, vega, theta) for a European call option from the Black-Scholes formula and explain their use in a hedging book.
Design a jump-diffusion (Merton) model for option pricing and derive its characteristic function incorporating the jump-intensity parameter.
Prove the existence of a unique equivalent martingale measure in a complete market model, and connect it to the second fundamental theorem of asset pricing.
Design an optimal market-making model incorporating adverse selection costs from informed order flow, and derive the resulting bid-ask spread decomposition.
Derive the exact solution to the Heath-Jarrow-Morton no-arbitrage drift condition for forward rate dynamics under a given volatility structure.

Design a globally-orderable, causally-consistent multi-datacenter storage system and prove it cannot simultaneously achieve real-time linearizability without unbounded latency, using an impossibility argument.
Derive the exact expected generalization error of kernel ridge regression in the high-dimensional proportional asymptotic regime, connecting it to random matrix theory.
Design a fully formally verified TCP/IP stack's congestion-control module and specify the stability proof it must satisfy under adversarial packet loss.
Prove the PCP theorem's role in establishing hardness-of-approximation for MAX-3SAT, sketching the gap-amplification construction.
Design a post-quantum secure multi-party computation protocol combining lattice-based commitments with garbled circuits, and prove its security against a quantum adversary.
Prove tight lower and upper bounds on the communication complexity of the set-disjointness problem, and use it to derive a streaming lower bound for distinct-element estimation.
Design a formally verified distributed consensus protocol tolerant to both crash and Byzantine faults simultaneously under a mixed-fault model, with a machine-checked safety proof.
Derive the exact convergence rate of natural gradient descent on an overparameterized neural network and connect it to the Fisher information matrix's conditioning.
